alternatives.notes: Considered: permitted, but the policy elects FIFO and the subledger does not tag disposals to lots.

judgments.basis: ASC 350-60-50-2 requires disclosure of the cost basis method; Treas. Reg. 1.1012-1(j) requires wallet-by-wallet identification for units held on or after 2025-01-01.
judgments.proposedConclusion: FIFO applied wallet by wallet, consistent with the policy and with the Treas. Reg. 1.1012-1(j) wallet-based identification requirement for tax; the same method is used for book to avoid a book-tax lot divergence.
judgments.question: Which lot relief method applies, and is it applied per wallet or across all wallets?
